videos.title: FIIs bought ₹4,865 crore on Monday, DIIs sold ₹3,519 crore

beats.say: Foreign investors were net buyers of 4,865 crore rupees in the cash market on Monday.
Domestic institutions were net sellers of 3,519 crore rupees the same day.
Here are the last eight sessions. Foreign investors were net buyers on every one of them.

videos.title: Urban Company launches ₹2,500 crore QIP
videos.hook: Urban Company opens a *₹2,500 crore* QIP

beats.say: Big announcement! Urban Company has launched a qualified institutional placement to raise 2,500 crore rupees.

scene.text: Urban Company launches a *₹2,500 crore* QIP

beats.say: The company said 600 crore rupees of the money will go to InstaHelp, its home cleaning and housekeeping business.
The shares slipped about 2 percent in morning trade after the news.

videos.description: Urban Company launched a ₹2,500 crore QIP; ₹600 crore is earmarked for its InstaHelp business, as reported by Business Standard.
videos.caption: Urban Company launches ₹2,500 crore QIP; ₹600 crore for InstaHelp.

videos.title: Nifty Bank crosses 62,000 · FIIs keep buying · Urban Company QIP | Market Samachar Daily

beats.say: Ding ding! On Monday the Nifty 50 closed at 25,291.10, up 0.58 percent, and the Sensex ended at 82,104.79.
And this morning, Nifty Bank crossed 62,000 for the first time.

scene.text: Nifty Bank crosses *62,000* for the first time

beats.say: Foreign investors bought a net 4,865 crore rupees on Monday, and they have been net buyers for eight sessions in a row.
Domestic institutions were on the other side, net sellers of 3,519 crore rupees.
Urban Company launched a 2,500 crore rupee QIP. It says 600 crore rupees will go to its InstaHelp business.
The RBI ran a two day reverse repo auction. It notified 50,000 crore rupees, received offers of 7,627 crore, and accepted all of them at a cut off of 5.49 percent.
From the events calendar: Concord Biotech's 1:1 bonus. One bonus share for every share held.
And Ksolves India paid an interim dividend of 1 rupee per share.
